text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of Smart Falcon's debut race is finally here, and she's visibly nervous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite having the strength of will to put on performances that nobody shows up to, she can't escape the pre-race jitters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I assure her she can win any race on dirt, and she heads to the starting gate with renewed confidence.
